scope: Only existing GSE73661 matrix header and sample registry read. No GSE73661 expression downloaded or accessed. Recommendations below are not a scientific-model freeze.

source_provenance.endpoint_source_excerpt: Response was defined as endoscopic mucosal healing (Mayo endoscoipc subscore 0 or 1)
source_provenance.endpoint_assessment_window: IFX W4-6 after first IFX; explicit in overall_design and per-sample source descriptions.
source_provenance.endpoint_interpretation: Endoscopic mucosal healing at the follow-up biopsy, defined by Mayo endoscopic subscore 0 or 1. This is neither total-Mayo clinical response nor change-in-Mayo response, and is not the clinical-response endpoint used for GSE23597.

consistency_checks.registry_response_field_note: Registry response is blank for all IFX arrays. Derived endoscopic_healing is stored only in the new pair table, with its explicit source rule; existing blank fields are not overwritten or treated as missing clinical-response values.

dose_and_time_limits.observed_IFX_path: All 46 IFX samples are labeled IFX; no IFX switch path is present in this subset.
dose_and_time_limits.numeric_dose: Not released in the existing header/registry; do not assume 5 mg/kg, equal dosing, or an individual infusion schedule.
dose_and_time_limits.actual_followup_week: All 23 follow-up samples are only labeled W4_W6, including title W4/6 and source W4-6. Which patients are W4 versus W6 is not released.
dose_and_time_limits.time_heterogeneity: A 4-to-6-week sampling window is documented, but patient-specific timing heterogeneity cannot be quantified or adjusted using this single-level deposited field.
dose_and_time_limits.non_IFX_paths: The VDZ/placebo induction-maintenance paths and their W6/W8/W12/etc visits belong to separate contexts and are not pooled into the IFX precision cohort.

precision_model_recommendation.reason: Matches the requested longitudinal conditional association while naming the actual source endpoint and retaining the same fixed candidate/inflammation object. Treatment is constant within this IFX-only subset.
precision_model_recommendation.visit_covariate: Do not add the observed W4_W6 field: it has one level and would be constant/aliased. Do not invent a W4/W6 split. If independent documentary actual times are later recovered before expression analysis, revisit a visit term under an explicit amendment, not an outcome-driven choice.
precision_model_recommendation.dose_covariate: No numeric dose variation is available for an estimable dose term.
precision_model_recommendation.precision_scenario_boundary: Residual variance and correlation of response with baseline candidate/inflammation covariates remain unknown before expression. Use explicitly labeled variance/covariate-correlation scenarios; do not present metadata-only leverage or an assumed effect size as observed full-model precision.
precision_model_recommendation.additional_available_metadata: Baseline endoscopic Mayo (2 or 3) is available, but not silently added as a new covariate by this review.

interpretation_limits: This cohort can evaluate association with endoscopic healing in an IFX treatment context; it is not an exact replication of the GSE23597 Week8 clinical-response estimand.
A later contextual result cannot retrospectively convert the failed GSE23597 frozen primary test into a successful one.
Source-ID pairing and endpoint agreement are established from metadata; gene coverage, actual log scale, score behavior, full-model estimability and results remain unassessed.
The header describes RMA-produced log2 probe-set values for GPL6244; future expression handling must verify the deposited scale and avoid repeat log2/normalization.
mutation_scope: Only new dedicated files in runs/002B_precision and this new provenance/reviews/002B_* JSON written. No old manifest, registry, frozen input or scientific lock modified.
